text:
Laura: Hey team — opened a docs PR to update the model catalog for the Llama-3 family. It adds supported sizes, token limits, perf numbers, and compatibility notes for quantized variants. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
Mike: Link looks good. Do we have a canonical source for the bench numbers? I remember the perf table used 2k seq vs 8k seq.
Anish: Benchmarks come from infra/bench/llama3-run-2025-01-15. Raw numbers here: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/benchmarks/llama3/summary.csv
Zoe: For the model card, we need to list max_context for each size and note that 16k is eval-only for 70b. Also call out KV-cache behavior on deduped tokens.
Tyler: SDK snippet needs a small tweak — new model id is 'llama-3-70b-8k' not 'llama3-70b'. I'll paste the snippet:
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model='llama-3-70b-8k', input='Write a short summary...')
print(resp.text)
```
Laura: Nice catch, Tyler. Can you add that to the PR? Also add a note under "compatibility" about FSDP checkpoints not supported for quantized checkpoints.
Mike: Quick QA: are the latency numbers p95 or p50? The table shows p95 but not labeled.
Laura: Good call — I'll mark the column p95 and add a footnote about the test harness (batch=1, seq=1024, A100-80GB).
Anish: One more: quantized variants (4-bit) are only validated on CUDA 12.1 + custom kernels; add a compatibility note and link to install guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/install/quant-kernels
Zoe: I can review the model-card language tomorrow. If nobody objects I'll merge after docs-bot checks pass.
docs-bot: automated check — broken link found in CHANGELOG.md (line 142) :warning:
Laura: Fixing CHANGELOG link now.
Tyler: Also add a migration note for customers on Dedicated: 'if you pin a model alias, change to exact model id' — short snippet under migration guide.
Mike: I can do a quick pass on the benchmarks wording after lunch.
Zoe: :shipit: pending one more review from Mike.
Laura: Thanks all — assigning reviewers @Zoe @Mike @Tyler. I'll update the PR with the inline edits.
